description: This file exports types, functions, and constants related to Discord monitoring, such as allow lists, message handlers, media payload builders, native commands, provider setup, and threading utilities.

methods.name: allowListMatches
methods.description: Checks if a given entity matches the allow list criteria.

methods.name: isDiscordGroupAllowedByPolicy
methods.description: Determines if a Discord group complies with policy.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordAllowList
methods.description: Normalizes the Discord allow list data structure.

methods.name: resolveDiscordChannelConfig
methods.description: Resolves the configuration for a Discord channel.

methods.name: resolveDiscordChannelConfigWithFallback
methods.description: Resolves Discord channel config with fallback options.

methods.name: resolveDiscordCommandAuthorized
methods.description: Checks if a Discord command is authorized.

methods.name: resolveDiscordGuildEntry
methods.description: Resolves a guild entry within Discord.

methods.name: resolveDiscordShouldRequireMention
methods.description: Determines if a mention is required for a command.

methods.name: resolveGroupDmAllow
methods.description: Checks if group DMs are allowed for a certain context.

methods.name: shouldEmitDiscordReactionNotification
methods.description: Decides whether to emit a reaction notification.

methods.name: createDiscordMessageHandler
methods.description: Creates a handler for processing Discord messages.

methods.name: buildDiscordMediaPayload
methods.description: Builds media payloads for Discord messages.

methods.name: monitorDiscordProvider
methods.description: Sets up the Discord provider for monitoring.

methods.name: resolveDiscordReplyTarget
methods.description: Resolves the target for Discord replies.
